title: An Open-Source, Event-Driven Pipeline for Cryptocurrency Market Data: Ingestion, Forecasting, and On-Chain Fraud Detection
abstract: arXiv:2608.29973v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Cryptocurrency markets generate high-frequency, multi-source data that is expensive to work with unless a team already has commercial-grade streaming and warehousing infrastructure in place. This paper describes a fully open-source pipeline that reproduces the behavior of a cloud-native, event-driven system -- file arrival triggering a message, a message triggering compute -- entirely on commodity hardware, using Apache Kafka and a filesystem-watching poller in place of managed cloud triggers. The pipeline partitions historical Gemini exchange data into hourly and minutely files, ingests them asynchronously through two independently grouped Kafka consumers (one for audit logging, one for Spark-triggered ETL), and lands cleaned output in a PostgreSQL warehouse with historical and aggregated schemas plus asset-specific data marts. translated_title: 一个面向加密货币市场数据的开源事件驱动管道：数据摄取、预测与链上欺诈检测
translated_abstract: 加密货币市场产生高频、多源的数据，除非团队已经拥有商用级的流处理和数仓基础设施，否则处理成本十分高昂。本文描述了一个完全开源的管道，它在普通硬件上完整复现了云原生、事件驱动系统的行为——文件到达触发消息、消息触发计算——使用 Apache Kafka 和文件系统监视轮询器替代托管云触发器。该管道将 Gemini 交易所的历史数据划分为每小时和每分钟文件，通过两个独立分组的 Kafka 消费者异步摄取（一个用于审计日志，一个用于 Spark 触发的 ETL），并将清洗后的输出存入 PostgreSQL 数仓，其中包含历史与聚合模式以及针对特定资产的数据集市。我们利用由此生成的比特币数据集市，将季节性 ARIMA 模型与单层 LSTM 网络进行对比……
tldr: 本文提出一个完全开源的事件驱动数据处理管道，在普通硬件上借助 Apache Kafka 与 PostgreSQL 复现云原生级系统，实现加密货币市场数据的摄取、预测建模与链上欺诈检测。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a fully open-source, event-driven pipeline that replicates cloud-native cryptocurrency data processing on commodity hardware using Apache Kafka and PostgreSQL, enabling data ingestion, forecasting, and on-chain fraud detection.
